about: The opening as the owner approved it on 2026-10-23 (Professor Chosen, with Kappi as his assistant): every line, its speaker (a look id) and expression, and the opening’s own commands, in order, played on a stub with Pat and Starterbill. opening-script.test.mjs compares the opening with it; a change to the opening’s words changes this file on purpose.

said.text: Whoa. WHOA. You fell out of the sky and you’re alive? That’s a main character move. That’s my move.
Stuff comes down through the crust sometimes. Mostly furniture. Furniture has never once been chosen.
He means: are you hurt? Take your time. Nothing down here is in a hurry. Except him.
Quick, what’s your name? Is it epic? It’s not “The Chosen”, right? That one’s taken.
Nothing? Not even your name?
Amnesia. Classic origin story. I’d be jealous, but I already have one.
Fall-related amnesia. Very common down here. It comes back slowly. Most good things do.
Okay. Sit up. Let’s see what the prophecy has to work with.
Pat? Solid sidekick name. Not chosen-tier. But solid.
I’m Professor Chosen. Nobody gave me the title. It chose me. That’s how chosen works.
I’m Kappi. People add “the Wise”. I do the research. He does the… presence.
These are Billies. Clones of the richest people up top. A lab copied them for fun and filled the gaps with animals.
Then dropped them down here. They went wild. Most of them nap on me now.
They live in the long grass, in caves and canyons, even in the malls. Walk, and they come to you. Catch them with a pyramid, train a team, earn badges from the arena leaders.
Every hero needs a companion. Not me, obviously. You. I’ve got three right here.
Three Billies, three types. Each one beats one of the others. Choose wisely. Like I would.
Starterbill! Bold. I’d have picked that one too. I didn’t. But I would have.
One more thing. See the airship at the mast? It flies out past the island, to wild places nobody’s mapped yet.
Every trip is different. Take Starterbill, catch what you can, bring back whatever you find. Side quest. Very important side quest.
And come back in one piece. Falling once is plenty. There’s a hot bath in the lab. Yuzu in it.
Go whenever you’re ready. The lab’s always open. So is destiny.
